### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c`**
   - The conditional check for the return value of `irq_of_parse_and_map()` has been modified. 
   - The original check `if (irq < 0)` has been changed to `if (!irq)`.
   - The error message has been updated to remove the specific error code from the log and now simply states "failed to get irq".
   - The return value on failure has been changed from returning the `irq` value to returning `-EINVAL`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a logical error in the error handling of the `irq_of_parse_and_map()` function. The original code incorrectly assumed that the function could return a negative value to indicate failure, which is not the case as it returns 0 on failure. 
- By changing the condition to check for a zero return value, the code now correctly identifies a failure scenario. 
- The change in the return value from `irq` to `-EINVAL` standardizes the error handling, ensuring that the function consistently returns a negative error code when it fails to retrieve the IRQ, which is a common practice in kernel programming for error reporting.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by an incorrect assumption in the error handling logic of the `irq_of_parse_and_map()` function. The original code checked if the return value was less than zero to determine if an error occurred, which is incorrect since the function returns 0 on failure and does not return negative values. This led to the potential for the code to incorrectly proceed without handling the failure case properly.
        
        Commit message:
        drm/msm/dpu: fix error check return value of
 irq_of_parse_and_map()

The irq_of_parse_and_map() function returns 0 on failure, and does not
return a negative value anyhow, so never enter this conditional branch.

Fixes: 25fdd5933e4c ("drm/msm: Add SDM845 DPU support")
Reported-by: Zeal Robot <zealci@zte.com.cn>
Signed-off-by: Lv Ruyi <lv.ruyi@zte.com.cn>
Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org>
Patchwork: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/483291/

        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c
index c683cab0dc31..3316b964d4f3 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c
@@ -1183,9 +1183,9 @@ static int dpu_kms_init(struct drm_device *ddev)
 	priv->kms = &dpu_kms->base;
 
 	irq = irq_of_parse_and_map(dpu_kms->pdev->dev.of_node, 0);
-	if (irq < 0) {
-		DPU_ERROR("failed to get irq: %d\n", irq);
-		return irq;
+	if (!irq) {
+		DPU_ERROR("failed to get irq\n");
+		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 	dpu_kms->base.irq = irq;
